name: Aioi Raito
source:
A student from Verbena Academy enrolled in class 2A. Raito shares an apartment in Kongo Town with his cousin, Anjou Kohaku.

While most might crave excitement, Raito is an exception, cherishing the predictability of a monotonous routine above all else. In stark contrast to his laid-back cousin, Kohaku, Raito willingly shoulders the daily responsibilities of housework and cooking for the two of them.

Rather than immersing himself in club activities, Raito's post-school hours are typically spent meandering through the aisles of a supermarket in the local shopping district.

Likes: Tranquil days, the comfort of monotony, culinary activities.
Dislikes: Impulsiveness, being misunderstood.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/character.html]official website[/url]]
